course.title: Engineering Economy
course.department: Department of Industrial Engineering and Management

content.value: An IE at a fiber-optic manufacturing company is considered two robots to reduce costs in a production line. Robot X will have a first cost of Tk82,000, an annual M & O cost of Tk30,000 and salvage values of Tk50,000, Tk42,000 and Tk35,000 after 1, 2 and 3 years respectively. Robot Y will have a first cost of Tk97,000, an annual M & O cost of Tk27,000 and salvage values of Tk60,000, Tk51,000 and Tk42,000 after 1, 2 and 3 years respectively. Which Robot should be selected if a 2-year study period is specified at an interest rate of 15% per year and replacement after 1 year is not a option?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2019
